methodology: Release; 3 process trials/variant/page, 200 warmup frames, 600 alternating paired samples, exact software pixels before timing. Phase p50/p95/p99, no GL/vsync or rasterization timed. Gates: sum of construction and layout/paint medians <= 2x direct; construction p95 overhead <= 0.5 us/node; app bytes/frame <= direct + 1024. Phase sums are not full-frame quantiles.
limitations: Actual Windows execution unavailable and unrun
Zero additional wrapper allocation applies to allocation-conscious library workloads; full gallery pages allocate
Native full-window GL channels permit the existing one-byte normalized conversion rounding bound
Reserved frame arena remains 64 KiB despite reduced used bytes; timings are hardware-specific
